parse_numpydoc_string: parse a numpydoc-formatted string into a structured mapping of sections
build_function_documentation: build structured documentation from a Python function's docstring using FunctionDoc
build_class_documentation: build structured documentation from a Python class including methods and attributes using ClassDoc
generate_doc_string_output: generate a reStructuredText docstring from a parsed NumpyDocString object
get_doc_object: get a typed doc object (class, function, or object) from any Python callable or class using get_doc_object
